Widened by the general authority clause, 'idha qala rabb al-mal li'l-mudarib i'mal fihi bi-ra'yika' (Mabsut 22, 48); narrowed by restriction, 'wa-law qala khudhhu mudarabatan ta'malu bihi fi'l-Kufa ... fa-'amila bihi fi ghayr al-Kufa fa-huwa damin' - a restriction of place is binding and breach makes him liable, whereas 'wa'mal bihi fi'l-Kufa' (with wa-) leaves him free to work where he wishes (ibid., 41).
